scope: minimal source-module, RG-connection and threshold theorem for the two completed portal operators; not a completed Pati-Salam loop calculation

minimalModulePackage.masterSource: one line bundle ell with coefficient Lambda
minimalModulePackage.countertermCondition: A iota=iota a, equivalently det(c_+,A c_+)=0
minimalModulePackage.thresholdCondition: T iota_up=iota_down tau, equivalently det(c_down,T c_up)=0
minimalModulePackage.additiveCondition: every additive pole s lies in im(iota)
minimalModulePackage.wardCondition: W must act contragrediently on sources and completed operators and be non-anomalous; invariant sources are then exactly Fix(W)=L

explicitMatrices.spurionParallelEquation: beta_u=(gamma_M-gamma_D)u plus vertex and threshold terms

typedLiftNoGo.typingObservable: K=diag(1,-1) distinguishes the Dirac particle-particle/bidoublet complex from the Majorana particle-conjugate/singlet-or-triplet complex
typedLiftNoGo.preservingActions: Every sourced Spin(2,3), Pati-Salam, family, grading, J-compatible linear action preserves the two typed summands, so [A,K]=0 and A is diagonal on E
typedLiftNoGo.exchangeFailure: W K W=-K, hence W does not preserve K and is not induced by any symmetry that preserves the sourced typing
typedLiftNoGo.intertwinerForm: A physical exchange requires an invertible typed intertwiner U:C_D->C_M and its inverse, giving W_U=[[0,U^-1],[U,0]]
typedLiftNoGo.homObstruction: The current sourced carrier has no such local gauge-, kinetic-, grading- and J-compatible U; the abstract map between the two gauge-contracted singlet lines is not a typed field lift

Spin23.reason: After contraction both operators are scalar singlets, so an action blind to the multiplicity leaves a two-dimensional source space; retaining constituent typing makes the two complexes inequivalent and removes the off-diagonal Hom. Neither side canonically selects one mixed line.

PatiSalamParity.reason: Left-right parity exchanges left and right Majorana branches and acts within the bidoublet sector; it does not exchange a Dirac bidoublet monomial with the right-Majorana monomial. Its induced action is block diagonal on E.

CPorJ.reason: Conjugation fixes a real plane of real dimension two. The antiunitary exchange z->W conjugate(z) also has a real two-dimensional fixed set. Their intersection is the real equal line only after the missing exchange W is independently imposed.

spurion.reason: A normalized off-diagonal spurion U can define W_U and a moving selected line, but its orientation and normalization are new data. Keeping a fixed line requires the parallel equation beta_U=Gamma_M U-U Gamma_D=0 and compatible threshold transport, which is the original Ward/RG problem.

decision.conditionalClosure: yes, if one adds a normalized typed intertwiner whose Ward identity is non-anomalous and whose line is parallel under the full RG connection and every threshold map

verdict: The exact minimum is a one-dimensional master-source bundle embedded in the two completed-operator source space, together with its reflection and a physical typed operator intertwiner. The first two exist formally. The intertwiner does not exist in the sourced Spin(2,3)/Pati-Salam data, and CP, J, parity or a free spurion does not derive it.
